plan.adoption: No production changes in this experiment. Stress-only wins do not justify general migration.
plan.cache_policy: Direct result cache disabled; MCP result cache cleared before every call. Other existing caches and OS/SQLite caches retained.

provenance.date_time_convention: source local clock represented as UTC for deterministic ordering
provenance.evidence_metric: complete annotated utterance text and original source span
provenance.indexing: one dialogue utterance per canonical user-role turn; speaker prefix; text only

plan.scope: Tested implementations at stated boundaries, not all possible programs in a language.
